source_line: Snapshot from the Daily Construction Report DCR-2026-0310 and the OAC Meeting (03/10)
legend_text: Priority: High / Med / Low.  Owner roles use trade labels for subcontractors.  This tracker is a working contractor record; financial items (PCOs, credits, pay applications) move through the change order and pay-application channels.

items.action: RTU-1 curb: engineer to review the deck condition found at the curb opening and give written direction; hold the curb set at RTU-1 until directed.
Submit PCO-001 for the RTU-1 deck repair with a full breakdown (description, qty, unit cost, total; labor by hours and rates).
Send written notice of the concealed condition at RTU-1 to the owner and engineer per the contract.
Field verify the deck and support condition at each remaining curb as it is opened.
Weatherproof every open curb at the end of each day.
RFI-001: confirm the start-up and commissioning sequence for RTU-1 and RTU-2 with the engineer.
Confirm the duct transition order with Sample Supply; final measure after the curbs are set.
Sample Electric to confirm the disconnect locations at RTU-1 and RTU-2 against the submittals.
Submit the monthly pay application for the period ending 03/31.
Continue before and after photo documentation of the roof, curbs and deck.
